annotations.title: finwire lead forecasts: core inflation and impaired loans

description: Use for core inflation in 6-12 months and for impaired (Stage 3) housing and consumer loans in 2-4 quarters. Give the 80% interval and the backtest coverage. If published is false, there is no forecast to give. Two finwire.pl models with 80% intervals. finwire_cost_pressure (Presja kosztowa finwire): NBP core inflation y/y in 6 and 12 months from a unit labour cost proxy, producer prices and the EUR/PLN change. finwire_npl_forecast (Stres kredytowy wyprzedzający finwire): share of impaired (IFRS 9 Stage 3, KNF) housing and consumer loans in 2 and 4 quarters from the WIBOR 3M change, unemployment and the portfolio trend. A forecast is shown only when at least 70% of actual readings fell inside the 80% interval in the rolling backtest; otherwise published is false and only the accuracy statistics are given. A model estimate, not investment advice.
